en.hubeali:
Ali, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘How ugly is the poverty after the enrichment, and the ugliness of the sinning after the destitution, and uglier than that is the worship of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, then leaving His<sup>azwj</sup> worship’.
en.sarwar: 6. Ali has narrated from his father from al-Nawfali from al-Sakuni from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “
The Messenger of Allah has said, ‘How ugly is poverty after riches, sin in destitution and worst of all worshipping Allah and then giving up His worship.’”
